title: Medical societies release female-specific framework for cardiovascular disease prevention, care
summary: Four major medical societies developed the framework, calling on providers to approach cardiovascular risk through a female-specific lens.

title: Anthropic lays out drug R&D ambitions, risks in mammoth IPO filing
summary: Artificial intelligence giant Anthropic is pushing deeper into drug discovery, building its own molecular biology lab and investing in research that could eventually produce drug candidates, according to the company's blockbuster IPO filing.
